title: Tuesday - Ziyarat of Imam Zayn al Aabedeen, Imam Muhammad Baqir & Imam Jafar Sadiq (a)
categoryChain: Tuesday - Ziyarat of Imam Zayn al Aabedeen, Imam Muhammad Baqir & Imam Jafar Sadiq (a)
introduction:
ZIYARAH OF IMAM ZAYN AL ABIDIN, IMAM MUHAMMAD AL BAQIR & IMAM JAFAR AL SADIQ (A) ON TUESDAY

This day is dedicated to the Imams Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-’Abidin, Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, and Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq - peace be upon them all. Their Ziyarah on Tuesdays is as follows:

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا خُزَّانَ عِلْمِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: Peace be on you, O depositories of Allah’s knowledge!

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا تَرَاجِمَةَ وَحْيِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: Peace be on you, O interpreters of Allah’s Revelation!
Peace be on you, O leaders to true guidance!
Peace be on you, O signs of piety!

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا اَوْلَادَ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: Peace be on you, O descendants of Allah’s Messenger!
I recognize your rights,
I discernibly acknowledge your true standing,
I incur the hostility of your enemies,
and I show loyalty to your loyalists.
May Allah accept me, my father, and mother as ransoms for you!
Blessings of Allah be upon you.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَتَوَالٰى اٰخِرَهُمْ كَمَا تَوَالَيْتُ اَوَّلَهُمْ
verses.translation: O Allah, I am willingly showing loyalty to the last of them just as I have shown loyalty to the first of them,

verses.arabic: وَ اَبْرَاُ مِنْ كُلِّ وَلِيْجَةٍ دُوْنَهُمْ
verses.translation: I release myself from any confidant other than them,

verses.arabic: وَ اَكْفُرُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَ الطَّاغُوْتِ وَ اللَّاتِ وَ الْعُزّٰى
verses.translation: and I reject all idols, false deities, al-Lat, and al-'Uzza.
Blessings of Allah be upon you, O my Masters!
Mercy of Allah and His benedictions be upon you, too.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَ الْعَابِدِيْنَ وَ سُلَالَةَ الْوَصِيِّيْنَ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O master of the worshippers and descendant of the Prophets’ successors.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَاقِرَ عِلْمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O he who split open the knowledge of the Prophets.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَادِقًا مُصَدَّقًا فِي الْقَوْلِ وَ الْفِعْلِ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O veracious and honest in all [your] words and deeds.
O my Masters! Today is your day,
which is Tuesday,
and on this day, I am your guest
and I am in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and treat me as your neighbor,
[I ask you] by Allah’s standing with you
and with your Household, the pure and immaculate.
